name: ketrik-firestore-studio
description: Firebase & Firestore database explorer, query builder, and editor with table views, security rules, and emulator suite.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Firestore Studio requires credentials and network access to cloud resources.

serviceAccountKeyPath.description: Path to Firebase Service Account Key File

authEmulatorHost.description: Firebase Auth emulator host (host:port, e.g. localhost:9099)

ketrik-firestore-studio.serviceAccountKe.description: Legacy path to Firebase Service Account Key File (auto-migrated to connections)

ketrik-firestore-studio.pagingLimit.description: Number of documents to show per page for each collection

ketrik-firestore-studio.maxTableRows.description: Maximum number of documents the collection table view will load in total. Every loaded document is a billed Firestore read, so keep this low; use Lookup to fetch specific documents.

ketrik-firestore-studio.cacheTTLSeconds.description: Cache lifetime in seconds for virtual document files and tree browsing. Keeps browsing snappy and saves Firestore read quota. Saves invalidate the cache immediately.

ketrik-firestore-studio.retainWebviewTab.description: Preserve background webview DOM and scroll position in memory for collection tables and cost simulator tabs. If experiencing high memory usage on machines with constrained RAM, set to false to allow VS Code to aggressively reclaim background tab memory.

ketrik-firestore-studio.autoRevealDocume.description: Automatically reveal, expand to, and highlight documents in the Explorer Tree View when opened from the collection table view or editor tabs.

ketrik-firestore-studio.checkRemoteChang.description: If enabled, performs an extra Firestore read before saving to warn if the document was modified by another party. Disabled by default so saves don't consume extra read quota and allow partial doc updates smoothly.

ketrik-firestore-studio.initialFoldLevel.description: Initial folding level when opening a Firestore document in the JSON editor. Set to 1 to fold root keys by default, or 0 to keep fully expanded.

ketrik-firestore-studio.protectSystemKey.description: Safe Mode: Warn and require explicit confirmation when deleting or renaming System Envelope ('_') or Operational Protocol ('__') keys.

ketrik-firestore-studio.documentTemplate.description: Predefined JSON templates for quick document creation

data.description: Default JSON data for the document template

ketrik-firestore-studio.autoDiscoverEmul.description: Automatically detect Firebase configuration (firebase.json) and running emulators on workspace open.

ketrik-firestore-studio.emulatorStartupC.description: Shell command used to start the Firebase Local Emulator in the integrated VS Code terminal.

ketrik-firestore-studio.emulatorAutoConn.description: Automatically create or connect to the Firestore connection when a local emulator is running.

ketrik-firestore-studio.promptStartEmula.description: Prompt to start the local emulator when opening a workspace with firebase.json if not already running.

ketrik-firestore-studio.showEmulatorStat.description: Show the Firebase Local Emulator status indicator in the VS Code status bar.

ketrik-firestore-studio.costAlerts.daily.description: Daily Firestore document read threshold to trigger warning indicator in status bar and alerts (Default: 40,000, 80% of Spark free quota).
Daily Firestore document write threshold to trigger warning indicator in status bar and alerts (Default: 16,000, 80% of Spark free quota).

ketrik-firestore-studio.costAlerts.enabl.description: Display a notification alert when daily Firestore read/write quota exceeds configured budget thresholds.
